note: Reasoned exemptions from the consumer DX contract (`ui-cli check consumer-dx`). Each entry waives one rule for one component and states why. An entry that stops matching a real defect fails the check as a stale exception, so the list can only shrink by fixing the component.

exceptions.reason: A row renders an anchor the provider supplies, a button or a div depending on `href`, `onPress` and `loading`, so no single element type describes its ref; the provider's link contract carries no ref either. `className` and the standard attributes are forwarded.
